LESSON: BELIEF IN ANGELS • JIBRIL, • MIKAIL • RAQIB AND ATID, • MALAKUL MAUT (IZRAIL) • ISRAFIL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Angels • Jibril, • Mikail • Raqib and Atid, • Malakul Maut (Izrail) • Israfil
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Belief in Angels • Jibril, • Mikail • Raqib and Atid, • Malakul Maut (Izrail) • Israfil, part of Pillars of Iman in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the duties of angels? 2. Why did Allah (S.W.T.) create angels?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. name the angels of Allah, (Jibril, Mikail,Raqib and Atid, Izrail and Israfil),

2. match and sort the names of angels and their corresponding duties using flash cards/pocket boards,

3. find names of angels from a crossword puzzle, in pairs or small groups,

4. search and sing qasida on angels and their duties from a digital device,

5. brainstorm on the duties of angels in their lives, in pairs or small groups, and write the points in their notebook. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. name the angels of Allah, (Jibril, Mikail,Raqib and Atid, Izrail and Israfil),
2. match and sort the names of angels and their corresponding duties using flash cards/pocket boards,
3. find names of angels from a crossword puzzle, in pairs or small groups,
4. search and sing qasida on angels and their duties from a digital device,
5. brainstorm on the duties of angels in their lives, in pairs or small groups, and write the points in their notebook. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Belief in Angels • Jibril, • Mikail • Raqib and Atid, • Malakul Maut (Izrail) • Israfil together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skills of speaking and writing are enhanced as learners discuss the significance of

angels in their lives, in pairs or small groups, and write their points in their notebooks.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced as learners find names of angels

from a crossword puzzle, in pairs or small groups.

• Self–efficacy: the skill of effective communication is enhanced as learners sing qasida on angels and their duties from a

digital device.

13

Values:
• Responsibility: self-drive as learners search and sing qasida on angels and their duties from a digital device.

• Respect: open-mindedness as learners respect each other’s opinions as they discuss the significance of angels in their lives.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness as learners will be cautious in carrying out his duties.

Link to other Learning Areas:

English: reading skills as learners acquire new vocabularies while discussing the names of angels and their duties.
